q: As per the AP State Reoganization Act 2014, the Tax Revenue from Hyderabad City is
options: Sharable at 50:50 percent between A.P and Telangana
Sharable at 30:70 percent between A.P Telangana
Sharable at 20:80 percent between A.P Telangana
No share will be given to AP
key_text: No share will be given to AP
explanation: The Act gives AP no share of Hyderabad's tax revenue: taxes belong to the successor State where the property or place of assessment lies (s.50), i.e. Telangana; only the Finance Commission award was apportioned by population (s.46).

notes.text: - **APRA 2014 gives AP no share of Hyderabad's tax revenue** – taxes accrue to the State where the activity is (Telangana); only the 13th FC award was split by population (Sec. 46).
